tweets.text:
BREAKING: Senior Advisor to the Secretary for the Coast Guard Mr. Sean Plankey and Acting Commandant Adm. Kevin Lunday spoke with the workforce regarding Force Design 2028’s People Campaign. This campaign is driving efforts to reshape our maritime fighting force, including: 15,000 new military members by 2028, increased access to medical care, a modernized Coast Guard Reserve, faster civilian hiring, and enhanced training. 

Through Force Design 2028, we’re empowering and investing in our Coast Guard men and women. Learn more here: https://t.co/XityiodE2w 

#USCG #ForceDesign2028 #People @DHSgov

tweets.text:
This week, @USCG leaders visited the site where the keel will soon be laid for the new Waterways Commerce Cutters! These ships, supported by historic investments in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, will replace our aging river tender fleet. Designated the Chief Petty Officer Class, Waterways Commerce Cutters will be named to honor the legacy of the Coast Guard’s senior enlisted leaders. The cutters will modernize our ability to facilitate $5.4T in commerce, protect our vital ports and waterways, and advance America’s economic security. 

#USCG #ForceDesign2028 #WCC @DHSgov

Securing 31,000 miles of maritime borders, one interdiction at a time. 

On the frontlines of @USCG border security operations, USCGC Forrest Rednour interdicted 13 aliens off Point Loma. Through superior vigilance and unmatched capabilities, the Rednour’s crew is leading our efforts to protect America’s maritime borders, territorial integrity, and sovereignty. 

#USCG #bordersecurity #WeOwnTheSea @DHSgov

tweets.text:
Today, we honor VJ Day—the end of WWII and a testament to courage, sacrifice, and unity. On Sept. 2, 1945, freedom prevailed, and the Coast Guard stood proudly alongside our fellow armed services, securing victory and saving lives. 

We salute the Greatest Generation, whose legacy inspires our mission to defend America with honor, respect, and devotion to duty. 

Let us never forget their sacrifices. 

#USCG #WW2

Always ready for the future. 

Today, Coast Guard senior leaders hosted a town hall on the Technology Campaign of Force Design 2028—our plan to integrate cutting-edge technologies to meet tomorrow’s challenges. 
 
Through Force Design 2028, we’re modernizing our capabilities, adapting to outpace emerging threats, and transforming our fighting force to meet the Nation’s most urgent needs. 

Visit  the Force Design Technology Campaign webpage to learn more: https://t.co/LXDIwTGQat
